local_bind_address.description: Local address to bind to when making a connection (-B option). Leave empty to let the system choose.

crlf.description: Convert LF to CRLF on write and CRLF to LF on read (-c option).

fork.description: Fork a separate process for each accepted server connection (-f option).

quit.description: Close connection on EOF on standard input (-q option).

read_only.description: No data read from stdin, only written to socket (-r option).

verbose.description: Issue messages about connections to stderr (-v option).

write_only.description: No data read from socket, only written to stdout (-w option).

background.description: Fork into background, detach from tty, change cwd to root (-b option).

program.description: Command to execute for each connection. Stdin/out/err connected to socket (-p option).

loop.description: Accept new connection after one closes (only valid with -s) (-l option).

target.description: The host and port (e.g., 'example.com 443') or unix socket path (e.g., '/var/run/socket') to connect to or bind on.
